_provenance: Pre-Renewal Novice skills as documented by iRO Wiki classic and the rAthena pre-re skill database (facts only). resname = client icon in data\texture\유저인터페이스\item\<resname>.bmp. Quest skills are learned through NPC quests in the classic game; until those quests exist they are granted to new characters (documented simplification). Mage skills: SP, hits, cast time and after-cast delay per iRO Wiki classic (Medium-high confidence; Soul Strike / Napalm Beat delays Medium). DK_* and SH_* skills are Project Twilight designs adapted from Ragnarok Online DS skill concepts. Their numbers are Project Twilight balance values (documented in docs/design/CLASS_DARK_KNIGHT_SHAMAN.md), not DS data. RK_*, AB_*, and the other third-job prefixes are Project Twilight signature trees built on the same data-driven engine; they are balance values, not copied client skill formulas. Second-job, transcendent and custom-transcendent class trees are Project Twilight designs using the same data-driven active-skill engine; they are balance values, not copied client formulas. Dread Knight and Oracle also have their own two-skill continuations. Archer, Acolyte, Merchant and Thief first-job trees are Project Twilight designs using the same data-driven skill engine. Archer, Hunter, Sniper, Ranger, Bard, Clown, Minstrel, Dancer, Gypsy and Wanderer skills now declare their required weapon family.

NV_BASIC.name: Basic Skill
NV_BASIC.desc: Unlocks basic interface features as it levels. Level 3 lets you sit (Insert), level 9 is required for a job change.

NV_FIRSTAID.name: First Aid
NV_FIRSTAID.desc: Bandage your wounds to restore 5 HP. Costs 3 SP.

NV_TRICKDEAD.name: Play Dead
NV_TRICKDEAD.desc: Feign death. Monsters lose interest and cannot target you, but you cannot move or attack. Use again to get up. Costs 5 SP.

SM_SWORD.name: Sword Mastery
SM_SWORD.desc: Increases ATK by 4 per level with daggers and one-handed swords (not two-handed swords or axes). Mastery ATK ignores DEF.

SM_RECOVERY.name: Increase HP Recovery
SM_RECOVERY.desc: Every 10 seconds while standing still, recover 5 HP + 0.2% of Max HP per level. Healing items restore 10% more per level.

SM_BASH.name: Bash
SM_BASH.desc: A powerful strike: ATK +30% per level and HIT +5% per level against one enemy in melee range.

SM_MAGNUM.name: Magnum Break
SM_MAGNUM.desc: An explosion around you hitting every enemy within 2 cells: ATK +20% per level, HIT +10% per level. Fire element. Requires Bash level 5.

MG_SRECOVERY.name: Increase SP Recovery
MG_SRECOVERY.desc: Every 10 seconds while standing still, recover 3 SP + 0.2% of Max SP per level. Healing items restore 2% more SP per level (item part not yet applied).

MG_NAPALMBEAT.name: Napalm Beat
MG_NAPALMBEAT.desc: Ghost-element psychic blast on a target and the enemies around it (3x3). MATK 80% + 10% per level, divided among everyone hit. Cast time 1 s.

MG_SOULSTRIKE.name: Soul Strike
MG_SOULSTRIKE.desc: Ghost-element spirit bolts: 1 bolt per two levels (1-5) of 100% MATK each. +5% damage per level against Undead. Cast time 0.5 s. Requires Napalm Beat level 4.

MG_COLDBOLT.name: Cold Bolt
MG_COLDBOLT.desc: Drops one water-element bolt of 100% MATK per level on the target. Cast time 0.7 s per level, reduced by DEX.

MG_FIREBOLT.name: Fire Bolt
MG_FIREBOLT.desc: Drops one fire-element bolt of 100% MATK per level on the target. Cast time 0.7 s per level, reduced by DEX.

MG_LIGHTNINGBOLT.name: Lightning Bolt
MG_LIGHTNINGBOLT.desc: Strikes the target with one wind-element bolt of 100% MATK per level. Cast time 0.7 s per level, reduced by DEX.

SM_TWOHAND.name: Two-Handed Sword Mastery
SM_TWOHAND.desc: Increases ATK by 4 per level with two-handed swords. Mastery ATK ignores DEF. Requires Sword Mastery 1.

DK_AXEMASTERY.name: Axe Mastery
DK_AXEMASTERY.desc: Increases ATK by 3 per level with one- and two-handed axes only. Mastery ATK ignores DEF. Requires Sword Mastery 3 and Two-Handed Sword Mastery 3.

DK_CRITUP.name: Critical Rate Up
DK_CRITUP.desc: Raises critical chance by 1% per level (normal attacks only; target LUK shield still applies).

DK_AUTOCOUNTER.name: Auto Counter
DK_AUTOCOUNTER.desc: Brace for 0.4 s per level. The first melee normal attack (attacker range 2 or less) during the window is blocked and answered with a guaranteed critical strike. Ranged attacks and skills are not countered.

DK_DARKBREATH.name: Dark Breath
DK_DARKBREATH.desc: Inhale darkness: physical damage +5% + 3% per level for 60 s. Drains 1 HP + 0.6% Max HP every 2 s; ends by itself before HP falls below 10% (never kills).

DK_SHADOWQUICKEN.name: Shadow Quicken
DK_SHADOWQUICKEN.desc: Attack delay -3% per level for 60 s (ASPD cap 190 still applies). Drains 1 HP + 0.6% Max HP every 2 s; ends before HP falls below 10%.

DK_DARKWEAPON.name: Dark Weapon

DK_BLOODYCRASH.name: Bloody Crash
DK_BLOODYCRASH.desc: A brutal strike: ATK 150% + 30% per level. Heals 2% per level of the damage actually dealt (monsters only, not on a miss).

AL_RUWACH.desc: A burst of revealing spirit light around the target (3x3). MATK 100% + 14% per level. Cast 0.8 s.

AL_MACEMASTERY.name: Mace Mastery
AL_MACEMASTERY.desc: Increases ATK by 3 per level with maces. Mastery ATK ignores DEF.

MC_MAMMONITE.name: Mammonite
MC_MAMMONITE.desc: A money-powered strike on one enemy in melee range. ATK 180% + 28% per level. After-cast delay 0.7 s.

MC_CARTREVOLUTION.name: Cart Revolution
MC_CARTREVOLUTION.desc: A cart rampage around you (5x5). ATK 130% + 22% per level. After-cast delay 0.9 s.

MC_HAMMERFALL.name: Hammer Fall
MC_HAMMERFALL.desc: A ground-shaking hammer blow around you (5x5) with a 2% per level Stun chance. ATK 140% + 24% per level. After-cast delay 1.0 s.

MC_AXEMASTERY.name: Axe Mastery
MC_AXEMASTERY.desc: Increases ATK by 3 per level with axes. Mastery ATK ignores DEF.

TF_ENVENOM.name: Envenom
TF_ENVENOM.desc: A venomous dagger strike on one enemy in melee range. ATK 140% + 24% per level. After-cast delay 0.7 s.

TF_SANDATTACK.name: Sand Attack
TF_SANDATTACK.desc: Throws sand at an enemy, with a 3% per level chance to Blind (30 s). ATK 120% + 20% per level. After-cast delay 0.7 s.

TF_BACKSLASH.name: Back Slash
TF_BACKSLASH.desc: A quick slash from an unexpected angle. ATK 160% + 28% per level. After-cast delay 0.7 s.

TF_DAGGERMASTERY.name: Dagger Mastery
TF_DAGGERMASTERY.desc: Increases ATK by 3 per level with daggers. Mastery ATK ignores DEF.
